title: Iterative Critique-Refine Framework for Enhancing LLM Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2510.24469v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Personalized text generation requires models not only to produce coherent text but also to align with a target user's style, tone, and topical focus. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches such as LaMP and PGraphRAG enrich profiles with user and neighbor histories, but they stop at generation and often yield outputs that drift in tone, topic, or style. We present PerFine, a unified, training-free critique-refine framework that enhances personalization through iterative, profile-grounded feedback. In each iteration, an LLM generator produces a draft conditioned on the retrieved profile, and a critic LLM - also conditioned on the same profile - provides structured feedback on tone, vocabulary, sentence structure, and topicality. The generator then revises, while a novel knockout strategy retains the stronger draft across iterations. translated_title: 面向增强LLM个性化的迭代式批评-精炼框架
translated_abstract: 个性化文本生成要求模型不仅能产出连贯的文本，还需契合目标用户的风格、语气和主题关注点。现有的检索增强方法（如LaMP和PGraphRAG）通过用户和邻居的历史记录来丰富用户画像，但这些方法止步于生成阶段，其输出往往在语气、主题或风格上发生偏移。我们提出了PerFine，一个统一的、无需训练的批评-精炼框架，通过迭代的、基于用户画像的反馈来增强个性化。在每次迭代中，一个LLM生成器根据检索到的用户画像生成草稿，而一个批评者LLM（同样基于相同的用户画像）就语气、词汇、句子结构和主题相关性提供结构化反馈。随后生成器进行修改，同时一种新颖的淘汰策略在迭代过程中保留更强的草稿。我们进一步研究了额外的推理时策略，如Best-of-N和主题提取……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PerFine——一个无需训练的统一批评-精炼框架，通过让批评者LLM基于同一用户画像对生成器草稿提供结构化反馈并迭代修正，结合新颖的淘汰策略保留更优草稿，从而显著增强LLM个性化文本生成。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PerFine, a unified training-free critique-refine framework in which a critic LLM provides profile-grounded structured feedback on the generator's drafts and iteratively refines them with a novel knockout strategy, significantly enhancing LLM personalization.
